question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.
sql:
-- Check the types more carefully - cast integers properly
WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        m.id as movie_id,
        m.date_published,
        m.duration,
        r.avg_rating,
        r.total_votes,
        r.median_rating
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
),
director_with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        movie_id,
        date_published,
        duration,
        avg_rating,
        total_votes,
        median_rating,
        LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published) as prev_date
    FROM director_movies
),
inter_movie AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        movie_id,
        duration,
        avg_rating,
        total_votes,
        median_rating,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_date IS NOT NULL THEN 
                CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (date_published - prev_date)) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE NULL 
        END as inter_duration
    FROM director_with_lag
),
director_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        COUNT(*) as movie_count,
        CAST(ROUND(AVG(inter_duration)) AS INTEGER) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) as avg_rating,
        CAST(SUM(total_votes) AS BIGINT) as total_votes,
        MIN(avg_rating) as min_rating,
        MAX(avg_rating) as max_rating,
        CAST(SUM(duration) AS BIGINT) as total_movie_duration
    FROM inter_movie
    GROUP BY name_id
)
SELECT 
    ds.name_id,
    n.name,
    ds.movie_count,
    ds.avg_inter_movie_duration,
    ds.avg_rating,
    ds.total_votes,
    ds.min_rating,
    ds.max_rating,
    ds.total_movie_duration
FROM director_stats ds
JOIN names n ON ds.name_id = n.id
ORDER BY ds.movie_count DESC, ds.total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9

inter_movie AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        movie_id,
        duration,
        avg_rating,
        total_votes,
        median_rating,
        CASE

            ELSE NULL 
        END as inter_duration
    FROM director_with_lag
),
